/* selectUserRights2 - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT E."LEVEL", E.MENU_NO, E.MENU_NM, E.UP_MENU_NO AS UP_MENU_ID, (SELECT F.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 F WHERE F.MENU_NO = E.UP_MENU_NO) AS UP_MENU_NM, E.MENU_LEVELA_NO, E.RM_CN, E.TOP_MENU_ID, (SELECT F.MENU_NM FROM SAB200 F WHERE F.MENU_NO = E.TOP_MENU_ID) AS TOP_MENU_NM, E.URL_ADDR, E.PROGRM_NM, E.PROGRM_ID, E.RIGHT_VIEW, E.RIGHT_DETAIL, E.RIGHT_INIT, E.RIGHT_CREATE, E.RIGHT_UPDATE, E.RIGHT_DELETE, E.RIGHT_MANAGE, E.RIGHT_EXISTS FROM ( SELECT LEVEL, C.MENU_NO, C.MENU_NM, C.UP_MENU_NO, C.MENU_LEVELA_NO, C.RM_CN, ( SELECT D.MENU_NO FROM SAB200 D /* 메뉴 */ WHERE D.MENU_LEVELA_NO = 1 START WITH D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO CONNECT BY PRIOR D.UP_MENU_NO = D.MENU_NO ) AS TOP_MENU_ID, (SELECT G.URL_ADDR FROM SAB100 G /* 프로그램 */ WHERE G.PROGRM_ID = C.PROGRM_ID) AS URL_ADDR, (SELECT G.PROGRM_NM FROM SAB100 G /* 프로그램 */ WHERE G.PROGRM_ID = C.PROGRM_ID) AS PROGRM_NM, C.PROGRM_ID, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{userId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS RIGHT_VIEW, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.DTL_INQ_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{userId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS RIGHT_DETAIL, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.INITL_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{userId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS RIGHT_INIT, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.REG_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{userId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS RIGHT_CREATE, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.MDFCN_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{userId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS RIGHT_UPDATE, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.DEL_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{userId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS RIGHT_DELETE, (SELECT NVL(MAX(D.MNG_BUTTON_USE_YN), 'N') FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{userId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS RIGHT_MANAGE, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(D.USER_ID) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM SAB250 D /* 사용자별 메뉴권한 */ WHERE D.USER_ID = #{userId} AND D.MENU_NO = C.MENU_NO) AS RIGHT_EXISTS FROM SAB200 C /* 메뉴 */ START WITH C.UP_MENU_NO = 0 CONNECT BY PRIOR C.MENU_NO = C.UP_MENU_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY C.SRTNG_SQNCE ) E
